item.description: Weekly Wrist Arthroscopy Literature Digest — 2026-08-16 Pulled from PubMed across the six target journals — JBJS Am, J Hand Surg Am, Plast Reconstr Surg, J Wrist Surg, J Hand Surg Eur Vol, and Hand Clinics. Restricted to articles focused on wrist arthroscopic techniques. Author line = first & senior author; corresponding-author institution listed per article. 33 articles. The 7-day window was empty again — this is a second, deeper catch-up issue. The entry-date search for 2026-08-09 to 2026-08-16 returned zero citations, and per the standing rule the search was repeated by publication date (also zero). Widening to 30, 90 and 365 days surfaced only one PMID that had never appeared in a Tutor digest (42059558, the bilateral dynamic CT paper, previously screened out twice as an imaging-protocol study). Every other citation in the 12-month pool was already covered by the 2026-07-03 through 2026-08-09 digests — 61 PMIDs in total. What we did instead. The window was widened to 24 months by publication date in the same six journals and cross-referenced against all seven prior wrist digests. That surfaced 34 never-covered arthroscopic citations from the 13-to-24-month band — the 2024 and early-2025 issues of J Wrist Surg, J Hand Surg Am and J Hand Surg Eur Vol that last week's 12-month catch-up did not reach. Thirty-three are featured below; one was excluded as an editorial. Combined with last week's issue, the program's arthroscopic coverage of these six journals now runs continuously back to mid-2024. Screened and excluded. One arthroscopic citation was dropped: Arthroscopic Treatments for Scapholunate Ligament Injury (Nakamura T, International University of Health and Welfare, Tokyo), J Wrist Surg 2025, PMID 40688644 — an editorial with no abstract, excluded per the standing filter. Separately, a full anatomy-only sweep of the six journals over the last 45 days returned 33 new wrist/carpal citations, none of which mentions arthroscopy anywhere in the title or abstract (wrist denervation, volar-rim morphology, pronator quadratus repair, 4DCT kinematics, carpal tunnel release, Madelung deformity, Kienböck capitate shortening, and similar). All were excluded as non-arthroscopic. The niche is genuinely dry, not under-searched. One paper from our own group is included and labelled — no outreach was drafted to it. A 90-day publication-date dp sweep, run as a cross-check, surfaced two further qualifying articles — 42524681 and 42524591 — that every entry-date edat window (7, 30 and 90 day) had missed. Both carry an ahead-of-print PubMed date from 2025 even though their Entrez entry date is 2026-07-29 and their issue date is August 2026, so edat filed them outside the window. Both were confirmed absent from all five prior digests. Future runs must pair the edat window with a dp sweep — entry date alone silently drops back-dated ahead-of-print records, which in this niche was two of the three papers for the week. Journals with no qualifying articles this week (5): J Bone Joint Surg Am, J Hand Surg Am, Plast Reconstr Surg, J Hand Surg Eur Vol and Hand Clinics each had zero newly-indexed wrist-arthroscopy technique citations. Most patients (20/28) presented six or more weeks after injury, and most (20/28) had dynamic or predynamic rather than static diastasis.
